audit.method: independent credential-free GET captures of official BRDE listing/detail surfaces, sitemap, and principal PDFs; inventory prepared before adapter comparison; no repository diagnostic selector, no other post-repair slot, no production API/DB/workflow mutation

capture_policy.retained: sanitized relevant page extracts, listing rows, lifecycle periods/status evidence, document URLs, response metadata, and SHA-256 hashes
capture_policy.omitted: raw HTML, scripts, cookies, authorization headers, nonces, and PDF/document bytes
capture_policy.comparison_boundary: the committed adapter function was run only after this source inventory was built
capture_policy.prohibited_paths: repository diagnostic selector, other post-repair audit slot, production API/DB/workflow, OCR, and submission
